set.body:
Outcome

Separate scientific oracle evidence from implementation-shaped snapshots.

Acceptance

- Fixtures carry schema version, axes, estimand metadata, source provenance, software versions, and digests.
- Crossnobis bias, RDM order, classification, canonical, MANOVA, and one-shot families have independent courts.
- Regeneration invokes the authoritative R or external implementation where claimed.
- CI detects stale or silently changed fixtures.
set.title: P7.3: version neutral parity fixtures and enforce generator freshness
